notes: Ratings are snapshots, not live feeds. Null means no verified score; not zero.
IMDb IDs come from matched title and director records, scores from the official daily dataset.
Rotten Tomatoes uses the critics Tomatometer; Metacritic uses critics Metascore.
Letterboxd values are rounded to one decimal in the UI.
User screening editions, durations, credits and keys are preserved.
The Doulist has 84 items: 82 match the existing festival films; two extra titles were not added. Linka Linka is absent from that list and uses the supplied festival portrait.
